data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded prior-year net reserve releases of GBP 8.5m in 2018, driven primarily by favourable development in Treaty Property catastrophe (the report cites 'HIM losses'). This release represents approximately 2.1% of opening gross claims outstanding. The report only quantifies the prior-year movement on a net basis (after reinsurance), with no explicit gross prior-year movement provided.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior year net reserve releases totalled GBP 8.5m the movement was primarily in Treaty Property CAT in relation to the HIM losses.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) 'Claims outstanding' 2017 comparative column. The report does not present an explicit GROSS movement for prior-year reserves; only a net prior-year release is stated ('Prior year net reserve releases totalled GBP 8.5m'). Therefore the prior year development figure used is NET of reinsurance (flagged). A gross prior-year movement could not be located in the movement notes; used the explicit net sentence instead. 'HIM losses' is referenced but not defined in the report; interpretation of its scope is uncertain. Claims development triangle (gross) is present and captured; no RITC indication was found that would invalidate triangle usage.
